messages:
maria: FYI — planning to rename header `X-Path-Affinity` -> `X-Ingress-Tag` across SDKs (py/ts/go) in v1.9.0. Rationale: unify with the new router metadata and avoid confusion with session-affinity semantics.
chen: timeline?
maria: aiming to land canary next week, full rollout two weeks after. We'll have a 30d fallback that mirrors old header to new key for backwards compat.
sam: will the console/dashboard and quota attribution pick up both header names during the migration? want to avoid double-counting.
maria: good call — ingestion needs to normalize to a single field (we'll canonicalize to `ingress_tag`). plan: ingestion layer maps `X-Path-Affinity` -> `ingress_tag` and drops duplicates.
igor: telemetry currently logs as `route_key` in our evens schema — are we changing schema or emitting an alias?
maria: we'll emit `ingress_tag` as the primary telemetry field and add a short-lived `route_key` -> `ingress_tag` copy in the agent so old dashboards don't break. schema bump will be minor and backward-compatible.
devex-bot: please remember to add migration snippets to the SDK changelogs and an upgrade guide in the docs repo (:memo:).
maria: snippet for docs: ```python
headers = {"X-Ingress-Tag": "team=search,profile=web"}
resp = client.generate("...", headers=headers)
```
jordan: TS client note: our fetch wrapper lowercases header keys. confirm expected canonicalization so folks on TS don't accidentally send `x-ingress-tag` vs `X-Ingress-Tag` mismatches.
chen: we'll document canonicalization and add unit tests in each client to assert header normalized key name in outgoing request.
ops-bot: canary deployed to staging (canary-3) at 2024-05-12T14:03Z — traffic redirected 1% to canary.
sam: any perf or quota anomalies so far?
maria: none in staging so far; will watch console metrics closely during canary. please monitor per-route token counts and billing attribution.
chen: who owns the console ingestion mapping change?
sam: i'll take console ingestion + dashboard tile adjustments. will add a legend that shows "ingress_tag (was X-Path-Affinity)" for the transitional period.
igor: i'll open the telemetry schema PR and add compatibility tests in the metrics pipeline.
maria: action items: update SDK changelogs and add code examples (maria), add ingestion normalization in console (sam), telemetry schema PR + pipeline tests (igor), SDK unit tests and docs (chen/jordan). target full rollout date 2024-05-26.
jordan: ack
sam: ack
igor: ack
devex-bot: Reminder queued: migrate-notes doc created at sources/docs/migrations/ingress-tag-migration.md (internal link). :bell:
maria: thanks — will follow up with a short RFC for the deprecation schedule and a one-pager for customers with examples for common proxies (nginx/envoy).
